issue.title: test_post_dispatch_foreign_race_on_external_is_exempt fails: unpushed-HEAD guard fires before the external-repo exemption

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic; fails in isolation and on a clean tree at master 3a4178b15a (2026-10-07, found during the sase-1hf landing check). The test raises `BuiltinCommitFinalizerError: sase stitch create --resume completed for research, but HEAD is ahead of its upstream with unpushed commits and no commit_results.json entry was recorded` (src/sase/finalizers/controller_cycle.py:281). The message originates in the commit dispatch/repair paths (src/sase/finalizers/commit_dispatch.py, commit_dispatch_followup.py, commit_repair_conflict.py), which recent sase-1h9 hardening changed (5230c3080e dispatch conflict repair resume, da0aad15f2 revision pin after repair-remaining). The post-dispatch foreign-race exemption for external repos now appears to hit the new unpushed-HEAD guard before the exemption applies. Root cause not yet confirmed.

issue.creation_reason: A finalizer discard-guard test is deterministically red on master after the sase-1h9 commit-repair hardening; found while landing sase-1hf and owned by no active epic.
